Consider the relation account (customer, balance) where customer is a primary key and there are no null values. We would like to rank customers according to decreasing balance. select A.customer, count(B.customer)
from account A, account B
where A.balance<=B.balance
group by A.customer
Query2:
select A.customer, 1+count(B.customer)
from account A, account B
where A.balance<B.balance
group by A.customer

specification but Query2 is not

implementation  of the specification
